reviews.title: Forcing AI w/ Massive Price Hike
reviews.text:
Been using Evernote for at least a decade. Bending Spoons made it better but they raised pricing from $69 to 129 a year, and now nearly doubling that to $249.99 a year! And the cheaper $99/y option limits the amount of notes and still gives you AI. So rather than give a non-AI option at a reasonable price, they limit the CORE notes feature and FORCE you to pay for AI. 

I’ve stomached a lot of price changes from Evernote over the years but this is unconscionable treatment of core users that have stuck around.

Exporting and moving as soon as I decide on which of a dozen options out there to move to.

reviews.title: Feedback on the recent UI changes
reviews.text:
Why do the interface updates keep making the experience worse?

The previous cursor indicator clearly showed when another person was actively editing a note. It was helpful, unobtrusive, and visually polished. Replacing it with a circular menu feels less intuitive and less attractive.

The new note highlighting is also distracting and does not improve the experience.

Please give users the option to keep the previous interface or choose the UI style that works best for them. Not every redesign is an improvement, and removing useful, well-designed features without an alternative makes collaboration less comfortable.

reviews.title: Bugs in Evernote
reviews.text:
Ever know has been going downhill rapidly over the last few weeks or months. It’s almost unusable on my phone at this point and it’s so slow and filled with bugs on the laptop that we’re ready to give up and shift to GROK4.7 and shift to using agents to manage the things we previously managed on Evernote and are now having to give up and just consider it our archive 

I understand you’ve bundled some type of integration with hugging face or something like that, but you need to get your code debug before you go live with it. This is very concerning that your company is letting down it users this way after all these years 

What is tell me about Evernote having use it for over a decade now this is dedication to being a Bake with respect to communication with his customers which would help in its product development

The second thing that stunning over this decade is how bugs are systemic never fixed

Certain features which are obvious such as nesting, are never integrated ever, despite valiant effort to get you to listen, but you don’t listen apparently, and I may as well be shouting into an empty dark room

Possible, you can admit that these are systemic to your original architecture and you can’t fix them, but it would be nice if you would be more honest and transparent with your loyal users

reviews.title: Animated ads that you can't stop
reviews.text:
They have added animated ads for their AI that you cannot x out of and it is loud with music. By the time I wait until I can x out of it, I have forgotten the important thing I needed to add to my note.
You used to have to click through a couple of ads, including an "I'm sure" one to get to your note, but I cannot abide this assault on my ears and productivity!
I've been wanting to switch to a different app for a while, but didn't want the hassle of copying and pasting all my notes to something new. To quote Arrested Development, today is: "I don't know why, but that's it."

As soon as I can migrate away, I’ll unsubscribe. Ulysses doesn’t do this to me. Ulysses is set up as if it cares to remain useful more than it cares about forcing me to interact with it.

reviews.title: Nonfunctional predictive text now line
reviews.text:
Recently the predictive text doesn’t work. I tap it but nothing happens - irritating. 

And, why doesn’t the update come through in the usual fashion (showing on the App Store icon)? I didn’t realize there was an update until I came here to write this comment. 

Also not a fan of the recent pricing structure. I’ve made it work for me at a reasonable cost but that meant downgrading my sub. … I like so much about this app but it makes me crazy sometimes that I have no control over lone spacing. For example, when writing/or copying a poem into the app I want the space between lines to be less than the space between stanzas. And there’s no way to reasonably cluster bits of lists together. And lists take up too much space, I want tighter spacing … this must be harder to do than I realize as it seems like such an obvious thing to include in a writing based app … I can dream!

reviews.title: Getting worse each year

Then they changed it into this bloated, overpriced, corporate subscription model. They gradually throttled back all free functionality so that I can now only access my notes on one device. And now… these horrendous audio-visual adds randomly interrupt my note reading. Screw you Evernote for hating your early users so much. Even if I was the type of user who would pay that much for an annual app subscription I wouldn’t choose Evernote based on the terrible user experience they’ve created for those of us who found it and liked it and talked it up to all our friends when it was free.

reviews.title: Not happy with latest version(s) of app
reviews.text:
I’ve been happy with Evernote for years, but lately the app has become frustrating to use. When trying to correct a word, the editing option is sometimes grayed out, so I can’t even select the word to fix it.

Even worse, the back button (<) that returns you to the notes list is right next to Undo. It’s far too easy to accidentally hit Undo when you’re simply trying to go back, and I keep doing it.

These are basic editing and UI issues that shouldn’t exist in a mature note-taking app. Evernote really needs to fix them.

reviews.title: Pervasive "what's new" pop-ups; wildly overpriced
reviews.text: I was a paid user of this app for several years, but finally downgraded to the free membership when I realized the functionality the app offered me as a basic user wasn't remotely worth $25 per month.  Sadly, with the limited plan, the pop-ups trying to upsell you into a paid version are so pervasive and annoying, rather than upgrade to a paid version to avoid them, I'm simply discontinuing use of the app altogether.  Talk about your all-time backfires.  And, even when you are a paid member, seemingly once a week there's an annoying "what's new" popup on the Home Screen that you have to click through before you can use the app.  Hardly efficient.

reviews.title: Used to live it, now hate it
reviews.text: I starting using this app many many years ago.  I absolutely used to love it.  Had it on multiple devices and had lots of notes on it.  Then they started to limit the amount devices you could have it on.  Later they started to limit the amount of notes you could have on the free version.   Soon after they started to force an ad up to try to get you to buy the paid version of the app.  You had to select no and then they made you verify you really meant no.  Now they have an AI ad video that pops up every time you open the app.  I open my shopping list while at the grocery store.  I’m in an isle with 20 people and the video just start blaring while I’m trying to look at my shopping list causing 20 people to stare at me.  When I say it pops up every time I mean every single time you open the app.  Even if I go look at a note for a split second and close the app before the video starts, it will actually start playing the video in the background.  You cannot close the video out, you have to wait for the video to end before you can close it out.  This is terrible when I’m in a meeting trying to make notes or look up notes.  I can’t tell you how embarrassing and frustrating this is.  They have absolutely ruined what was once a great app.
I’ve used this app for over 10 years and now I hate it. I use to love it. Now every time I go in to work on my grocery list I have an ad that pops up. Going to find something new.

reviews.title: These constant changes are not helpful.
reviews.text:
I’ve been using Evernote since around 2010. It’s had improvements over the years. Been bought and sold by different owners. Changes made. Price has gone up as has the price for everything else. Features come. Features go.

This year the price went from $150 a year to $260 a year. This for a bunch of features that were already deployed for the most part and that I hadn’t used quite frankly. Obviously, I’m invested in the technology since I’ve used it for 16 years. Not anxious to have to move everything to some other platform.

This week, I used Evernote to file photos that I took during a competitive review of our businesses. When I went back in to review the photos their “helpful” AI has not inserted an annoying AI assessment of what is in each image. 

Additionally, I use Evernote to house lyrics and charts for a music project that I play in. This week, all of the charts had been kicked down approximately 50 spaces on the page which required me to go in and edit every note to bring them back up to the top of the note - DURING THE PERFORMANCE. Super frustrating.

Obviously their testing criteria doesn’t involve user feedback.

reviews.title: Downhill Fast
reviews.text: This app used to be okay, a way to share notes between Android and iOS free. Now the free version has become SO FREAKING obnoxious and intolerable. Every single time you open it it’s trying to sell you a subscription and they try to hide the option to move on instead of just having an X. NOW they’ve started putting unmutable video ads that start playing randomly when you’re in a note trying to look something up, which CLOSES the note you’re in once the ad ends and pulls you back into a arm-twist “buy our subscription.” Trying so hard not to curse and get this review rejected, but I would NEVER, EVER download this app to use free and paying for a notes app monthly is kind of ridiculous with what exists free on your phone.

reviews.title: Subscription fee is crazy
reviews.text:
I’ve been a loyal Evernote user for the last 10 years. With no exaggeration, it is my external brain. I love all the capabilities however the recent price hike of 100% is insane. They no longer have a free option. Their starter tier is a joke and quite expensive. It seems that I’m grandfathered into their advanced plan that is now $265 a year. I’m currently weighing my options, but I suspect Evernote is going to lose a lot of customers over this price hike. Use at your own risk.

Update Sept. 18, 2026
The app has been completely unusable on my iPhone. Since the latest iPhone update, Evernote has not been working. Since the app immediately crashes when I open it, I’m unable to follow any of the troubleshooting instructions. If you’re going to charge big boy, prices, you should offer a big boy experience and support. This is not it!! Also, all app updates are annoying. I feel like I never get a chance to open the app without an update. Batch the fixes together and update at regular intervals,  unless it is a critical update.

reviews.title: Was a favorite app, $250 a year now? LOL
reviews.text:
Price jump from $99 to $250 a year. After 12+ years of using Evernote, I'm done. A ridiculous price increase of 250%. Move my hundreds of notes into the Apple Notes app.


Added a new note, ended up with 13 duplicate copies. What a joke.

So, I accessed a note, and added some info. That note now shows up 9 times in the far left column. Why? So, I now have one recipe in 9 separate notes. It saved each time I backspaced to correct my typing. I don't need 9 notes for one recipe. This is a huge bug. This update is horrible.

Ok, so you must use the EDIT button to edit a note. If you don't, you get multiple duplicates. Why can the keyboard be invoked for typing without using the Edit button? Lose that Edit Button.

September 2020 update is horrible. Why can't you view Notebooks on the left side in a column? Now to see them, it takes the entire page, and there is no threaded view of notes within their Notebook. Who designed this new interface? It's awful.

Evernote has become almost useless. It is slow, it locks up when trying to select text, it's difficult to find notes, everything that made this app so great seems to have been removed or changed.

No full view for notes in iOS? When I'm using Slide Over on my iPad Pro, once I find the note I need, I don't need the left side pane to stay up. I want to see the whole note. 

When trying to copy text, the menu comes up for Select and Select All...but this freezes the app, every time. The only way to unfreeze it is to use the Home but

reviews.title: Why so Serious!?!?

It would be nice to download, install, and start in less than 2 minutes.  Instead, after ten minutes, I’m writing this review, then deleting.  There must be a better option.  I’ve tried Evernote a few times out of the past 10 years or so.  Every couple years I try again to see if they have gotten better. The search goes on.

reviews.title: Confused about the meaning of Free
reviews.text:
“Free AI Humanizer.”
That sounded promising. So I clicked it.
Turns out “free” apparently means “free to find out that you have to pay.”
The actual humanizer immediately wants a subscription, so unless the hidden feature is teaching me how to read fine print, I’m not sure what exactly is supposed to be free.
Maybe call it “AI Humanizer — Pay Us First” next time. It would save everyone the confusion.

reviews.text:

Seriously? That’s what premium plans for leading AI platforms cost—and those tools could practically build an Evernote alternative from scratch.

reviews.title: Ad overriding phones silent mode
reviews.text:
I have used Evernote for over 15 years and was one of the first users. I have always had the free account and never had any issues till the last few years. It has become increasingly less useful and more restrictive unless I begin to pay for features that I had already had for many years. 
This is unacceptable. 
On top of that the app has begun to show an ad every time I open it that is on full volume, can’t be silenced and can’t be stopped. 
At no point should an app or ad be able to override the silent mode on my phone. 
It’s sad that the customers who helped make the product popular and told so many people to use it in the past are being punished with increasing restrictions and less usefulness of the app I helped promote. 
It’s to the point I’m thinking of transferring all my notes to a different app and definitely DO NOT RECOMMEND anyone use it.

Edit: Why on earth would you put the undo/redo buttons so super close to the back page “<“ in the top left? Impossible spacing and size for normal actions. Now you can accidentally hit undo with just trying to close the keyboard or exit out of a note. Terrible UI.

Search within a note “Find in Note” - will not work when their settings font size is set larger? Says the query is found, but cannot correctly bring it to the viewable screen? Settings>note font size- in your own app, destroys your search function? 
Zooming in on a note text is not a feature any more? So if I want to keep my notes larger when giving a lecture or client meeting, that zoom feature just got erased?

reviews.title: Used to love this app until they eliminated my plan
reviews.text: I loved using evernote as a personal notetaking, and pdf/picture saving of articles for all my personal data. Love having access to my digital filing cabinet wherever I am.  Sorting notes into notebooks is awesome. The best part is being able to add and edit notes into the cloud without them being stored on my phone. BUT… then evernore was purchased by Bending Spoon and went to only supporting corporate needs with a bunch of features I don’t need or want at a cost that was originally $30/year and now is $250. I’d be willing to pay more than $30 for the old unlimited storage, note, notebooks to upload notes, lists, check lists, pdfs, and some features that others find useful for personal use. There are many other users with similar online comments about being abandoned by evernote and said they have moved to different apps. I find it hard to believe that the non-corporate customers are not a profitable group for evernote in addition to the more expansive plans. Now, we have to put up with an obnoxious ad!  I am looking for a new service that is more responsive to customer requests.

reviews.title: Can’t Trust With My Notes
reviews.text: I have used Evernote since the beginning. I want to say I used it as early as 2011? But by 2016, I was a heavy user. I had EVERYTHING in there, from personal notes to alllll of my work notes. Most importantly, I had a series of nested journals, structured by month. I eventually paid the premium version for a number of years, but then I noticed glitches and things not synching correctly. Etc. But the scary thing was my old email address got compromised and I needed to update it, but I could not update the email address. Apparently, I had to email them and THEY had to update it, but no one would get back to me to validate the change. For the first time, I took a good hard look at my free Notes app on all of my Apple devices and realized they have come a long way. I still preferred what I had with Evernote (and again, I was a super user, using in all day long, every day. I had thousands of notes. Thousands of notes I would lose if I didn’t get the email address changed. I panicked and spend an entire night batching them into my (free) Notes account. I managed to save almost everything. For free. That was a few years ago and they may have fixed the email change problem, but it was so precarious to almost lose everything just for that….never again. And don’t even get me started on how  all the subscription models are like being pecked to death by a duck financially. Just no. Do I miss Evernote from time to time, when I wistfully see it as an option? Yes. But will I pay whatever ho

reviews.title: Very disappointed long term advocate
reviews.text:
I have been an Evernote user for over ten years. Today I was told my two-user Teams plan (already a steep £359 a year) is being discontinued, and that if I do nothing before renewal my account will be "automatically moved" to Enterprise Unlimited at £14,800 a year. 

A 40-fold jump aimed at a household account, with features I will never use: SCIM provisioning, SSO, a dedicated Customer Success Manager.
What makes it worse is there is no path down. No option to drop to a Personal plan, no proportionate tier for a small user. The only choices on offer are an enterprise contract or the door.
The supposed justification is the recent AI work, which has been underwhelming at best. After a decade of loyalty and steadily rising fees, being handed a £14,800 ultimatum is the clearest possible signal to leave. I am now moving ten years of notes to another system. Avoid unless you want your pricing held hostage at renewal.

reviews.title: Don’t value their customers.

They keep shoehorning more half-baked AI functionality in that no-one asked for, whilst not fixing long term bugs - for instance rendering of offline notes is blocked by a slow/missing connection - which is just the situation you need reliable offline notes in! This bug is at least three years old - no indication of when it’ll be fixed, if ever. The best thing they could do is roll back the app to what it was like around 4 years ago - it’s been downhill since then. 

Looking for an alternative - maybe even the basic apple notes.

reviews.title: Went From Annoying To Broken
reviews.text:
Are you looking for a notepad app you can spend TWENTY FIVE AMERICAN DOLLARS on each month? Evernote is the app for you! There is a free option that used to only pester you with multiple “give us money” pop ups that required multiple button presses to close, and it still does, but, cutting edge innovators that they are, they have added ads akin to the worst free phone game ads every time you open the app. If you’ve been craving an app that forces you to stare at “YOU GOT A VIRUS FROM AN ADULT WEBSITE THAT WILL DELETE ALL YOUR PHOTOS IN 3 MINUTES IF YOU DON’T DOWNLOAD THIS APP” for way too long before an arrow appears on the left that brings up a new screen you have to stare at for a while before another arrow appears on the left that you press to pull up a 3rd screen that finally has an X in the corner every time you need to make a grocery list, EVERNOTE IS FOR YOU! This isn’t all, by the way. There will be other “hey, wanna give us money to make this stop?” pop ups that may or may not occur, depending on the mood of the app. 
Evernote has been annoying for a while, just not quite annoying enough to make me copy and paste 15 years of notes to a new app, but they finally broke it enough with the scammy ads. There are numerous note apps that are ad free and don’t even have a paid option. Use one of them.

reviews.title: Flawed on iPhone
reviews.text: I’ve been using Evernote as my main note taking app for 3 months now. It has some cool features, and the desktop app treats me well. I like the voice transcriptions, and that you can use your iPhone settings to start recording a voice memo with the extra side button on newer phones, but I have a lot of issues too. Mostly with bugs. This app is a buggy, laggy, slow mess. If I have an idea, I don’t want to pause for a good seven seconds before I get to write it. Just today, I had an issue I needed to remember to present to my boss, I went to start writing, the keyboard was working but no words were writing. Tried opening a new note. Nada. Tried closing the app and reopening it. Nope. I had to step into a private space and do a voice memo and the transcription didn’t work. Forget about using it away from WiFi or cellular, the transcriptions don’t work and everything is even laggier. It offers some features in Apple shortcuts, but I couldn’t get many of them to work. I’m thinking about switching to something else the moment my subscription expires because I’ve had too many moments of frustration with the iPhone app.
